name: Ranger Mystic Blade
body:
Mystic blades are a cabalistic sect of rangers who gather under the cloak of night to study esoteric teachings they can use against their sworn enemies. With a devotion that borders on obsession, they use a combination of stealth, deadly combat skills, and arcane secrets that they channel directly through their weapons.

Weapon And Armor Proficiency

You are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with light armor, and with shields (except tower shields). You can cast spells gained from this archetype while wearing light armor and using a shield without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance. Like any other arcane spellcaster, you incur a chance of arcane spell failure while wearing medium or heavy armor if the spell in question has a somatic component.

If you are multiclassed, you still incur the normal arcane spell failure chance for arcane spells received from other classes.

This feature alters weapon and armor proficiency.

Cantrips

At 1st level, you learn a number of cantrips, or 0-level spells, from the magus spell list as noted on Table 1–1: Mystic Blade Spells Known. These spells are cast like any other spell (see below), but they do not consume any slots and may be used again.

This feature replaces wild empathy.

Esoteric Lore

You do not gain Knowledge (nature) as a class skill, but you do gain Knowledge (arcana) as a class skill.

This feature alters class skills.

Eschew Materials

You gain Eschew Materials as a bonus feat at 3rd level.

This feature replaces endurance.

Arcane Spells

Beginning at 4th level, you gain the ability to cast a small number of arcane spells, which are drawn from the magus spell list, except that only magus spells up to 4th level are considered to be on your spell list.

To learn or cast a spell, you must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. You can cast spells you know without preparing them ahead of time. The saving throw DC against one of your spells is 10 + the spell level + your Charisma modifier.

Like other spellcasters, you can cast only a certain number of spells of each level per day. Your base daily allotment of spells is given on Table 1–1: Mystic Blade Spells per Day, above. In addition, you receive bonus spells per day if you have a high Charisma score (see Table 1–3 on page 17 of the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook). You do not need to prepare these spells in advance; you can cast any spell you know at any time, assuming you haven’t yet used up your allotment of spells per day for the spell’s level.

Your selection of spells is limited. At 4th level, you know two 1st-level spells of your choice. You gain more spells as you increase in level, as indicated on Table 1–2: Mystic Blade Spells Known. Unlike spells per day, the number of spells you know is not affected by your Charisma score.

At 8th level and every 3 levels thereafter, you can choose to learn a new spell in place of one you already know. In effect, you lose the old spell in exchange for the new one.

The new spell’s level must be the same as that of the spell being exchanged. You may swap only a single spell at any given level, and must choose whether or not to swap the spell at the same time that you gain new spells known for the level.

This feature replaces spells.

Mystic Spellstrike (Ex)

At 4th level, choose either melee weapons or ranged weapons.

If you choose melee weapons, then whenever you cast a spell with a range of “touch” gained from this archetype’s spell list, you can deliver the spell through any weapon you are wielding as part of a melee attack. Instead of the free melee touch attack normally allowed to deliver the spell, you can make one free attack with your weapon, at your highest base attack bonus, as part of casting this spell.

If you choose ranged weapons, then whenever you cast a spell that calls for a ranged attack, you can deliver the spell through a ranged weapon you wield as part of a ranged attack. Instead of the free ranged attack normally allowed to deliver the spell, you can make one free ranged attack with a ranged weapon, at your highest base attack bonus, as part of casting this spell. The attack does not increase the spell’s range. If the spell can normally affect multiple targets, only a single missile, ray, or effect accompanies each attack; if the spell allows multiple attacks and the eldritch archer can make additional ranged attacks as part of a full-round action with spell combat, one additional ray, missile, or effect from the spell accompanies each subsequent ranged attack you make in the same round until all attacks allowed by the spell are made. Unused missiles, rays, or effects remaining at the end of your turn are wasted.

If successful, your melee or ranged attack deals its normal damage as well as the effects of the spell. This attack uses the weapon’s critical threat range, but the spell effect only deals ×2 damage on a successful critical hit, while the weapon damage uses its own critical modifier.

For the purposes of overcoming damage reduction, this spellstrike attack is considered to have an enhancement bonus equal to the spell being used.

When making a spellstrike attack against a favored enemy, add your favored enemy bonus to any concentration checks that you are required to make.

This feature replaces hunter’s bond.

Improved Armored Casting (Ex)

At 8th level, you gain proficiency with medium armor and can arcane spells gained from this archetype while wearing medium armor without incurring a chance for arcane spell failure. Like any other arcane spellcaster, you still incur a chance of arcane spell failure while wearing heavy armor if the spell in question has a somatic component.

This feature replaces swift tracker.

Instinctual Spell (Su)

At 11th level, you gain more flexibility with your spell list. Once per day, you can cast any 1st-level through 3rd-level spell on the magus spell list as if it were one of your spells known, expending a spell slot of the same spell level to cast the desired spell.

Casting a spell with this ability always has a minimum casting time of 1 full round, regardless of the casting time of the spell.

At 19th level, you can use this ability 3 times per day and can also use it to cast 4th-level magus spells.

This feature replaces quarry and improved quarry.
